name: math-it
description: Math It! — free printable mental maths worksheets for Years 2–6. Static, dependency-free, AdSense-ready.

scripts.build: npm run build:html && npm run build:css
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run serve

comments.test: The end-to-end suite needs Puppeteer and a server on :8080 — run `npm i -D puppeteer`, `npm run serve`, then `npm test`. Puppeteer is deliberately not a declared dependency so a plain `npm install` stays small.
